1879064371.name: Barbed Arrow
1879064371.desc: Your arrow can cause a wound that bleeds.

procEffects.description: DNT - Attacks have a chance to reduce your enemies Critical Defence for  short duration
On Every Harmful Skill, \n On Critical Hit:
On every Harmful skill,\n50% chance on Critical Hit:

1879072563.name: Disappear
1879072563.desc:
From beneath the very nose of your foe, you can disappear and prowl unseen once more. For a short while your stealth is extremely effective.<rgb=#FF7700> 
 
 In Flayer, Disappear becomes Topple. 
 Topple: 
 Knocks your target to the ground. </rgb>

1879073715.name: Aura of Command
1879073715.desc: When the fight has begun, your commanding aura allows your allies to fight more viciously.

1879090227.name: Thud
1879090227.desc: Pick up rock. Drop rock. Sometimes, hurt little things extra lots.

1879102643.name: Stagger
1879102643.desc: An attack that impairs the target, removing a corruption and reducing their combat readiness if you are flanking them.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you are hit by an attack, your Block/parry Ratings will increase by X.
DNT - Your attacks will deal additional damage based on the number of bleeds on your target.
DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.
Up to once per second, when you Block or Partially Block:

1879102771.name: Tactics Signal
1879102771.desc: Extends Tactics fellowship skill bonus to your fellowship.

1879132211.name: Hampering Javelin
1879132211.desc: Javelins can pierce body parts or equipment and slow the target until the javelin can be removed.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879139379.name: Thunder In The Hall
1879139379.desc: All area attacks do increased damage and their Fervour pip cost and Recovery Time reduced to 0.

1879159987.name: Prized Tame Redhorn-goat
1879159987.desc: The Iron Garrison Miners have been training Redhorn mountain-goats to use as mounts.  These sure-footed creatures can traverse the rocky passageways of Moria where no horse could go.  This is one of their tame goats, making it not as fast as others.

1879176371.name: Remorseless Strike
1879176371.desc:
Uses fervour to deal a devastating attack.

This attack is hard to defend.

Critical hits deal massive damage. 
 
 Critical hits will reset Emboldened Blades.

1879215027.name: Crude Map to Isendeep
1879215027.desc: A crudely drawn and horribly detailed map to Isendeep.

1879222195.name: Good Map to Grimwood
1879222195.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Grimwood.

1879244851.name: Clash of Steel and Will
1879244851.desc: This quick strike saps your target's morale and has a chance on a critical strike to restore morale to you and your war-steed

1879266867.name: Recuperate
1879266867.desc: A Champion knows when they must leave the din of battle for brief respite, relying on their War-steed for safety.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Fervour</rgb>

1879269683.name: Trickster: Dust in the Eyes
1879269683.desc: Blind the enemy, causing them to miss often.\n\nLimit: Trickster will allow this trick to stack.

1879317043.name: Bracing Roar
1879317043.desc: With a bellowing roar, unleash your Wrath and restore some Morale to yourself.

1879335475.name: The Farmer's Second Favourite Steed
1879335475.desc: A horse from the Farmer's Faire Festival.

1879343923.name: Sky of a Perfect Day Kite
1879343923.desc: Brings out a kite so you can always have beautiful blue skies and puffy clouds above your head.

1879354419.name: Hobbit-sense
1879354419.desc: Samwise Gamgee may not be strong, or fast, or indeed very smart... But he has plain old hobbit-sense and it serves him well.

1879360819.name: Agarnaith Crawler
1879360819.desc: Brings out an Agarnaith crawler to keep you company.

1879391411.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Elvish Squire)
1879391411.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879414195.name: Festive Yule Goat Kid
1879414195.desc: This little goat is dressed to celebrate.

1879465523.name: Spotted Jerboa
1879465523.desc: Summons a friendly jerboa to accompany you on your journeys.

1879469747.name: Rummage: Button
1879469747.desc: An old button that reminds you of home.

1879480627.name: Grabby Crab
1879480627.desc: Summons a crab to accompany you on your travels.

1879492531.name: Miasma
1879492531.desc: Your fell voice whispers to your stinging spores, forcing those nearby to burst forth into the flesh of your foes.

1879495347.name: Memory of Justice
1879495347.desc: A Memory of Justice can be used to punish creatures of evil.

1879508659.name: Young Striped Oryx
1879508659.desc: Summons a young striped oryx to accompany you on your adventures.

1879518771.name: Dash
1879518771.desc: In combat, push through your limits with a quick dash of immense speed.

1879529523.name: Mottled Mirkwood Doe
1879529523.desc: Summons a mottled Mirkwood doe to accompany you on your travels.
